        """Called to handle validation error.

        Args:
            value (str): String entered by user.
            error (InvalidResponse): Exception instance the initiated the error.

The issue is that `PromptBase.on_validate_error` prints the error message directly using `self.console.print(error)`, which might render raw markup if the console is configured to disable markup globally. The fix requires explicitly asking for markup in this method if the console has markup disabled.

The relevant function is `rich/prompt.py::PromptBase.on_validate_error`.

I will submit this location.
